answer_1.quote: We employ GPT-3 ... to augment the training data for each model. In particular, given the limited availability of labeled positive examples, i.e., tweets containing misinformation and tweets associated with specific themes of misinformation ... we employ a straightforward prompt-based approach to generate additional data.
datasets: multilingual dataset of COVID-19 vaccine misinformation from MIC

answer_2.quote: We employ the macro F-1 score (averaged over the 5-folds) as the performance metric to evaluate our models as the classification accuracy is not a reliable measure for evaluating model performance when the distribution of class labels in the dataset is highly skewed such as in our dataset

answer_4.quote: Two communication graduate students are trained as coders to examine the tweets for: (Q1) relevance to vaccine (yes/no), (Q2) mentions of specific non-COVID vaccine (such as the MMR vaccine) (yes/no), (Q3) presence of misinformation (yes/no/uncertain).
answer_4.guideline: coders are trained on the codebook and their agreement on how to apply the codes is measured with inter-coder-reliability (ICR), where high values imply that the coders consistently annotate the data and signal the high validity of the annotations.
